product_scope.runtime: offline static browser app; no runtime dependencies, account, or translation-service calls
supported_profiles: UTF-8 CSV catalog with unique source and target headers and optional id/context columns
UTF-8 TSV catalog with the same headers
Basic SubRip SRT cues with comma millisecond timestamps and increasing time ranges
WebVTT header and text cues, preserving cue identifiers/settings and NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks
explicitly_unsupported: Koei Tecmo native packages, archives, executables, proprietary string tables, and saves

preservation_checks: No-op exports are byte-identical for CSV, TSV, JSON, SRT, WebVTT, and TXT fixtures, including BOM and original line endings.
CSV, TSV, and JSON translations patch only target value spans; other source spans remain unchanged.
Subtitle edits preserve cue timing, identifiers, metadata blocks, and line endings; blank cue lines are rejected.
The browser reads an uploaded File and always downloads a new .localized copy; it has no path or game-folder write operation.
Unknown extensions, malformed profiles, invalid UTF-8, NUL-containing files, and oversized inputs fail closed.

coverage_notes: Six documented profile parsers and round trips
Malformed input and bounded resource rejection
